subject: general
question: Which among the following is NOT an example of an Operating System?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Office**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Operating System**
 
• An Operating System (OS) is an interface between a computer user and computer hardware.
 
• Some popular Operating Systems include Linux Operating System, VMS, OS/400, AIX, z/OS, Apple macOS, Unix Operating System, Microsoft Windows, Google's Android OS, Linux Operating System, and Apple iOS.
 
• Apple macOS is found on Apple personal computers such as the Apple Macbook, Apple Macbook Pro, and Apple Macbook Air.
 
• UNIX is an operating system that was first developed in the 1960s and has been under constant development ever since.
 
 
• By operating system, we mean the suite of programs that make the computer work.
 
• It is a stable, multi-user, multi-tasking system for servers, desktops, and laptops.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Linux**:

 
 
• An open-source operating system (OS).
 
• Known for its stability, security, and flexibility.
 
• Widely used in servers, supercomputers, and embedded systems.
 
• Offers a vast range of distributions (like Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian) tailored for different needs.
 
• Free to use, modify, and distribute.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNIX:**

 
 
• A powerful and versatile operating system that serves as the foundation for many modern systems, including Linux.
 
• Known for its multi-user and multitasking capabilities.
 
• Widely used in servers, workstations, and high-performance computing.
 
• Typically found in academic, research, and enterprise environments.
 
 
 
• **Windows:**
 
 
• A popular commercial operating system developed by Microsoft.
 
• Known for its user-friendly interface and wide software compatibility.
 
• Dominates the personal computer market.
 
• Available in various versions for desktops, laptops, tablets, and servers.
 
 
 
• **MS Office:**
 
 
• A suite of productivity applications developed by Microsoft.
 
• Includes popular programs like Word (word processing), Excel (spreadsheet), PowerPoint (presentations), and Outlook (email).
 
• Widely used in businesses, education, and personal use.
 
• Offers a range of features for creating, editing, and sharing documents.
